title: A student explains itself: the fields that moved each whisper, kept with it
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice, trusted only where it proves itself; 29.13: a student explains itself.
plan: How much each state field moved the answer, for any model: the answer's probability less the probability without that field.
The two or three strongest as the answer's reason.
On for the students answering in shadow, so every whisper in the ledger carries them.

decisions.decision: Occlusion, not a model's own importances.
decisions.why: It works for the logistic and the boosted students alike and speaks in the state's own fields, which a person can judge.
One prediction a field: the batched exams would pay twenty times their cost for reasons no one reads.

change: dclab_core.answerers.contributions and explain; ClassifierAnswerer answers with its reason when explain is on; the shadow students answer with it.
outcome: Every whisper of a student in the ledger says which fields moved it, so a person judges the reason and not only the answer.
lessons: Explain in the inputs' own vocabulary: a reason a person cannot read is no reason.
risks: Occlusion measures one field at a time: two fields that only matter together are each under-credited.
